headline: Mongolia's minimum wage to rise by more than 26% next year
summary: Mongolia's Ministry of Family, Labor and Social Protection announced a 26.3% increase in the minimum wage to ₮1,000,000 (about $277) starting next year.
why: Minimum wage changes affect labour costs for employers in Mongolia, a resource-driven economy whose mining sector is a major source of exports.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: В Монголии в следующем году минимальная заработная плата увеличится более чем на 26%
